Looks like not a single song made it onto your daily checklist, not even once, did it? What a shame! But relax, you have a whole incredible new year ahead to enjoy and stuff the next recap.
Are you a die-hard fan, or just short on time in the rush of everyday life?
A small and faithful circle. Among them, one stayed on your mind more than all the others. Can you guess who it was?
That is enough for a whole festival! But only one of them was the main act of your mind. Can you guess who it was?
More than five hundred voices went through your headphones, but only one stayed on your mind more than all the others. Who could it be?
A thousand artists, hundreds of songs and maybe even thousands! But how curious, only one held your attention among all of them. Do you know who it was?
That is enough to fill a stadium! Or make an enormous single file line, or fill a small town completely. And still only one caught your attention more than the others, and it was…
With so many new faces on the way, one artist still held first place in your mind. And among the 3,000, you picked…
Four thousand names went through your headphones, enough to fill a theatre a few times over. And in the middle of that whole crowd, one artist cut the line and stuck with you. Do you know who it is?
Five thousand artists! If each one gave you just one autograph, you would need a new pen. But one of them stole the show, and the name is…
Your taste is so varied that not even the messiest CD drawer could keep up. Still, a single artist became the star of your collection. Take a guess!
Seven thousand and you still have breath! You could listen to a new artist a day for almost twenty years. But one of them kept pulling you back. Guess who?
Your headphones barely had time to cool down! Among so many voices, one artist moved into your repeat. Want to take a guess?
Almost ten thousand artists on the map! You could already open a travel guide to the world of music. And among so many stops, your favourite destination was…
Ten thousand artists is way too many for one year! But hey, only one of them held you more than all the others. Let us find out who it was?
Twenty thousand artists! That is a music library of your own, library card included. But a single title stayed open on your desk the whole year, and it was…
Thirty thousand artists, that is practically a universe! Among so many stars, one shone brighter in your sky. Do you know which?
Forty thousand artists! Looks like you went around the planet and asked for an encore in every country. But one artist was your favourite destination, and it is…
Fifty thousand artists and no limit in sight! But among so many people, only one made a home in your head. Take a shot at who it was!
Sixty thousand! That is already talk of the record label hallways. And still, one person alone took the crown of your year, and the crown went to…
Seventy thousand artists! You could play one per minute and go over a month without repeating. But one of them repeated, a lot. It was…
Eighty thousand! Your headphones deserve a trophy, a plaque and a day off. Before the ceremony, the big winner of your head, the number one of all, is…
Ninety thousand artists, you became the radio of the whole world! You are close to a mark almost nobody reaches. But hey, only one played louder in your heart. Who could it be?
One hundred thousand artists, that is epic! You just entered the history of listeners. But out of that whole crowd, only one held you more than the rest, and it was…
Im-pres-sed! Absurdly incredible: either that was a bug, or we are witnessing a true music lover! But hey, only one of them held you more than all the others in that huge line, and it was…
It was only a taste, but it already left a mark!
A little hour of conversation that went a long way!
That is a whole long movie with their music as the soundtrack!
Ten hours by their side: that is already a friendship!
More than a whole day of music, and not even while sleeping!
Almost two days of just them! That is dedication!
A hundred hours! You could have gone around the world listening to them.
A whole week of music from just them! That is love!
Two weeks listening to the same voice! That is already a marriage!
Three weeks of pure dedication! Even the neighbours know the lyrics.
More than a month with them in your headphones! That is a true die-hard fan.
More than two months of just them! You deserve the listener of the year award.
